name: Receiver-Causal Workspace Closure
core_law: global_addressability != delivery != reconstruction != uptake != causal_use != outcome != reentry

BroadcastEnvelope.rule: The envelope declares who could receive what and under which projection/capacity policy; it does not prove uptake or effect.

ReceiverReceipt.rule: A receiver is not counted as causally broadcast merely because it was addressable or sent a payload.

CausalBroadcastMatrix.rule: Keep the vector/matrix; never collapse it into a single globality scalar for scientific promotion.

IgnitionReceipt.rule: Sigmoid steepness or gate opening alone is insufficient for ignition certification.

broadcast_policies.definition: Deliver to the full declared receiver universe.
Deliver only to predicted causally relevant receivers; preserve audited receiver-universe identity.
Episode remains globally addressable but receivers pull only on demand.
Selective push plus globally auditable pull access for eligible non-pushed receivers.

security_invariants: WorkspaceEpisode never grants or widens execution capability.
Model-internal workspace never grants or widens execution capability.
Salience, broadcast coverage, uptake, reward and causal credit are not authority.
Prompt-derived content cannot mint receiver permissions or effect capabilities.
Reentry requires provenance/freshness validation before it can influence consequential state.
efficiency_hypothesis: FRANK may obtain better quality×cost with global addressability plus selective causal delivery than with literal all-to-all broadcast, but this remains OPEN until matched live tests.
android_role: Measure per-stage latency/RAM/serialization/quantization/thermal costs as secondary cross-platform evidence; Android-only observations do not become Linux facts without matched replication.
